title: Scout I-S1 (telemetry inventory at Phase H code, READ wt/goal-T-0353): every field where tokens, usd, calls, turns, timestamps and outcomes are recorded per role, what scorecard computes today, and the field-by-field gap against the P0 metric list
spec:
Read-only. Work in /Users/k3ntaw/code/orchestrator/wt/goal-T-0353 (Phase H head 0d7bf09; the main checkout is older, ignore it). Program: .orchestrator/phase-i-program.md section P0. Deliver a matrix, one line per item, each with path:line.
1. Recording points: bus.log_run and every caller (spawn.run_worker, executor.start/reply, jev usage, planner_usage from transcripts, goals.launch_planner, planner_runs records): which fields each row carries today (role, task, goal, executor/model, tier, account, in/out/cache tokens, usd, turns, calls, attempt, decision kind/key, route reason, client/policy version, started/finished timestamps, exit status), and which rows lack which fields. Where memory recall and Jev usage are or are not recorded.
2. Outcome stamps: pipeline stamps and bus events that mark creation, dispatch, first gate pass (gated_at), gate_red, review verdicts, fix-round lineage (constraints.fix_round_for, auto_round), merge (merged_at, merged_into), acceptance (PR); which of these carry timestamps usable for time-to-first-green and time-to-accepted.
3. Scorecard today: what build/by_task/by_goal/by_role/--planner compute (tokens per accepted goal G1b, waste and turns E4, median/max H1, premium usage H2, fix rounds, Jev buckets), their input files and exact formulas; existing tests in tests/test_scorecard.py that pin them.
4. Gap table: for each P0 metric (tokens per accepted task, per accepted goal, tokens to first green, first-pass success rate, fix-round rate, avg fix rounds, fix-round tokens, cost per accepted task/goal, calls and turns per accepted task, time to first green, time to accepted, model distribution, pipeline amplification with the Planner/Scout/Execution/Fix/Spec review/Code review/Jev/Other breakdown, attribution by complexity band and task type, unknown bucket) say: computable now from existing rows (formula) / needs a new field (which row, which writer) / needs a new stamp. Name the smallest set of new fields.
Output under 1,500 tokens, confidence per section, provenance repo.
acceptance: matrix of recording points with fields present and missing, each with path:line
outcome stamps and their timestamps listed with path:line
scorecard formulas and pinning tests listed
gap table covering every P0 metric with computable-now / new-field / new-stamp and the smallest new-field set

findings.claim: bus.log_run appends one JSON line to runs/<date>.jsonl per call; fields kept: attempt, decision_kind, payload_key, route, route_reason, client_version, policy_version (dropped if None), plus goal_id/provider auto-set when task exists

spawn.run_claude (Claude workers) logs task,role,tier,account,duration_s,outcome,usd,turns,provider=claude,executor,complexity,packet_meta + raw usage(input/output/cache_read_input_tokens); on no_cli/rate_limit rows usd/turns/tokens are absent

executor._run (Codex) logs task,role=execute,tier=executor id,account=codex,provider=codex,duration_s,outcome,executor,complexity + normalized tokens via _tokens(); no usd field at all (Codex rows never carry cost)

mcp._bg only logs a spawn_error row (task,role,tier,complexity,outcome,reason) on worktree-creation failure; the success path spawns a thread and logs nothing itself, relying on spawn.run_worker's own log_run calls

planner_runs logs role=planner_decision with tier=planner, account, provider=claude, usd, tokens, raw usage+normalized, launch_id/route/reason/evidence/cheaper_steps/decision_requested/policy_version/prompt_hash/payload_key, route_reason, decision_kind, attempt, started_at, session_id -- richest row shape of any caller; rows are skipped entirely (never call log_run) when log missing, log unreadable, no JSON found, or usage empty (usage_logged=False)

goals.launch_planner starts the Planner session but does not itself call bus.log_run; Planner's own token usage is captured later by planner_runs (transcript-derived) and separately by pool._save_planner_account into planner_usage.json (day_tokens/window_tokens), a pool-wide daily tally not tied to a goal/task

Jev gate/rank usage never goes through bus.log_run: gate calls write to runs/jev/gate.jsonl (jev_gate.py) and generic Jev usage writes to runs/jev/<date>.jsonl (jev.py), both keyed on caller not role/task-role, so by_task/by_goal must read them as a separate code path, not via the runs/*.jsonl reader

Memory recall (claude-mem/recall.sh) is not recorded anywhere in runs/*.jsonl or bus fields -- no log_run caller or bus.update field for recall cost/hits exists in bus.py, daemon.py, planner_runs.py, or mcp.py

Outcome stamps live in task.pipeline{} written by daemon.stamp/complete: dispatched_at, spec_review_at/spec_review_held_at, gated_at (held on gate_red/no-commit/missing worktree, else success), review_held_at, merged_at, plus *_done and *_lease companions; all are time.time() epoch floats usable for time-to-first-green (created_at proxy via bus_events min ts, or task file mtime) through gated_at, and time-to-accepted through merged_at or PR open

Fix-round lineage: constraints.fix_round_for names the held ancestor task, constraints.auto_round is the round number; daemon counts rounds via sum() over the chain, and on merge the ancestor is marked merged_into the same target as its fix-round descendant

created_at is not a stored task field; daemon derives it ad hoc from min(bus_events timestamps) falling back to the task JSON file's mtime, only inside the respawn check, not exposed for scorecard use

Acceptance/PR stamp: task_pr_url/goals reads pr_url off the goal task; planner_runs._open_pr calls gh pr create and stores pr_url in the goal-closed result, but there is no pipeline timestamp for PR-open time, only merged_at per child task

scorecard.build() (--by executor/tier) computes per-executor merged/failed/rounds_avg/usd/tokens/held_usage_limit from runs/*.jsonl (execute rows only) joined to tasks/T-*.json (merged_into, status, rounds, review_verdict, complexity band); it has no goal or per-role breakdown

open_questions: Where exactly is task.created_at expected to be stamped — bus_create_task or daemon's first tick?
Is memory-recall cost intentionally out of scope for P0, or a real gap to fill?
suggested_next: Add pipeline.created_at stamp in bus.py's task-creation path
Add turns + estimated usd to executor.py's Codex log_run call
Wire JEV_USD_PER_M into by_goal's jev_by_goal to get Jev cost, not just tokens
